title: Adaptive Release Quickstart: Compact Tour & Fallback Recipes
creator: Ava Kim
description: Design a compact, developer-focused quickstart flow that teaches users how to create adaptive releases with version pinning, canary exposure, A/B splits, and automated fallback policies. Deliverables: a compact card-based tour (3 cards), two screenshot-ready product frames (canary + A/B), an interaction spec for the fallback policy composer, and two short GIF prototypes showing 'pin then fallback' and 'A/B promote' flows.
decisions: Use 3 compact cards instead of a long modal to reduce cognitive load for returning engineers.
Primary CTA on each card will be contextual (Create Canary, Open A/B, Configure Fallback) to drive task completion.
Prefer plain-text code snippets (copyable) over visual heavy examples so engineers can paste quick commands; include a one-line cli and an SDK snippet for JS.
Fallback composer exposes three presets (Immediate Rollback, Gradual Reduce, Route to Warm Model) and one advanced JSON editor for power users.
